text:
Kevin L: Quick idea — instead of the long freeform postmortem follow-ups we've been doing, can we try a 2-week 'after-action sprint' template to track remediations, owners, and recurring patterns?

Maria S: Yes please. Too many actions slip. What does the template look like?

Kevin L: Rough draft below. It's intentionally terse so owners can update status quickly in a weekly sync. Thoughts?

Kevin L: ```
After-action sprint (2w) — INCIDENT XYZ
- Owner(s): <name> (primary), <name> (backup)
- Priority: P0/P1/P2
- Goal: short one-line remediation objective
- Start: YYYY-MM-DD
- Due: YYYY-MM-DD
- Steps (each line small TO-DO with owner + ETA):
  - [ ] <task> — owner — ETA
  - [ ] <task> — owner — ETA
- Acceptance criteria / verification (how we know it's fixed)
- Rollout plan (canary / feature flag / revert plan)
- Post-change monitoring (metrics & duration)
- Recurrence check: record last two similar incidents and root cause pattern? yes/no
```

Alex P: Love the recurrence check line. Concrete ask: add a single field for "rollback window" and a short comms template for stakeholders.

Kevin L: Good call. Add: Rollback window: HH:MM, Comms snippet below.

Kevin L: ```
Comms (short):
Subject: Incident XYZ — remediation update (owner: <name>)
Body: TL;DR: Why this change is needed, what we changed, expected impact, rollback plan, monitoring pointers, contact.
```

Nina R: Operationally, I'd prefer owners be explicit about testing scope. Also propose a weekly 15-min 2w-sprint sync on Tuesdays for open items. Keeps it lightweight.

Maria S: Agree. Also suggest adding a "blocking dependencies" bullet so we don't stall due to infra or vendor waits.

Alex P: For IC rotation: can we pair ICs for handover? Week A primary IC + Week B backup, then rotate. That helps knowledge transfer and prevents single-person bottlenecks.

Kevin L: Proposed comms cadence:
- Day 0 (incident): incident channel + high-level update to ops inbox
- Day 1: postmortem draft + immediate short remediations assigned
- Week 1: 15-min remediation sync, update sprint items
- Week 2: final sprint review, close or escalate long-lived items to roadmap with PM owner

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: #eng-oncall 2w-remediation-sync every Tue 10:00 `@channel`

Nina R: If we move quick remediations to a timeboxed 2-week cycle, we should also require a minimal verification checklist for each item so "done" has meaning.

Maria S: Can someone own rollout docs templates? I'd volunteer to make a Google doc template and a Slack snippet for the comms bit.

Kevin L: Maria — that would be great. Alex / Nina — can you pilot the template on the next 2 incidents and report back in 3 weeks?

Alex P: I'll take 1st pilot.

Nina R: I'll take 2nd.

Kevin L: Cool. Action items:
- Maria S: create rollout + comms template (due in 5 days)
- Alex P: pilot after-action sprint on Incident A (start next incident)
- Nina R: pilot on Incident B
- Kevin L: add recurrence-checks to postmortem checklist and update the playbook (due 1 week)

Maria S: noted, will drop files in #eng-oncall and tag owners.

Kevin L: Thanks all. If no objections I'll add the template to the incident playbook and we can turn the weekly reminder on.

Alex P: +1

Nina R: +1

oncall-bot: Reminder created: 2w-remediation-sync recurring, starting 1823005000

Kevin L: Done — I'll plug this into the playbook and make a tiny PR for the docs.

Maria S: Thanks!
